name: jueguito-battle-royale
description: Battle royale 3D para navegador y Android (APK)

scripts.copy-three: mkdir -p www/lib && cp node_modules/three/build/*.js www/lib/ && rm -rf www/lib/addons && cp -r node_modules/three/examples/jsm www/lib/addons
scripts.sync: npm run copy-three && cap sync android
scripts.build:apk: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
